resources.string: Matches the original font. Load it to complete missing glyphs without replacing the paragraph’s styles.
This replaces the paragraph’s font after you apply it. Its text colors and sizes are retained.
Choose a complete, embeddable, openly licensed TTF or OTF font.
The font must be no larger than 16 MB.
The document changed. Select the paragraph again.
The selected font is ready in this document.
Import a font from your phone or download one from the library.
Download each family with all available weights, or install the whole collection at once. Saved fonts work offline. Choose a weight from saved fonts to preview it.
The selected font cannot show all the characters in this text. Choose another font.
The font could not be downloaded or verified. Check your connection and try again.
The original font %1$s is not available for automatic download. Import its complete TTF/OTF file, or preview a replacement. Your edit is kept.
Fonts available on this phone that can be embedded in an editable PDF. The matching original font is used automatically before downloading. Other fonts require preview and selection.
No supported phone fonts are accessible. Import a complete font or download a font family.
